defect: the shipped `mpd` preset could not MOUNT on the installed harness, so every mpd session failed to start
rootCause: `presets/mpd/agent.cordis.yml` still configured the persona row with the single `text:` key that `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` accepted through 0.1.2-rc.1. From 0.1.3-alpha.2 that row registers the deployment persona PREFIX/SUFFIX prompt sections and `prefix` is REQUIRED, so the row's config fails validation; `dsh-agent-presets.mountPreset` treats any inactive row as a preset-level failure (`inactiveRows`) and refuses the WHOLE preset, which rejects the session creation that triggered it.

reproduction.how: git show HEAD:presets/mpd/agent.cordis.yml into a QA preset root, boot the web profile in an isolated DSH_HOME/HOME, POST /api/session/create with agentPreset=mpd

reproduction.permanent_case: node skills/dsh-qa/scripts/preset-conformance.mjs — its negative control boots the same sandbox with the retired `text:` form and must fail

why_no_gate_saw_it:
`dsh --profile

--dump-config` composes rows and never executes plugin code (AGENTS.md §4).
`agentPresets.list`/`resolve` parse the composition for YAML shape + row resolvability only; config schemas are validated at MOUNT.
`preset-register` and `bundle-lifecycle` boot the profile but never create a SESSION, so the preset's standing mount never ran.

presets/mpd/agent.cordis.yml: add row `command-goal` (@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal): the Web overlay disables the HOST row, so presets own the human /goal command
add row `present` (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present): new in 0.1.5-alpha.2 and part of the shipped standard preset (Web deliverables row)
header: convention 4 — the preset is kept row-for-row equal to the installed shipped `standard` preset
tests/overlays/persona-oracle.yml + pers: `persona:` -> `personaPrefix:` (dsh-system-prompt schema; schemastery keeps unknown keys, so the old key was silently ignored)
skills/dsh-qa/scripts/preset-conformance: new case: offline conformance of every @deepseek-ai row config (preset + bundle patch + QA overlays) against the INSTALLED schemas, unknown keys included, `!!js` nodes materialized; row-id parity with the installed standard preset; real web boot + `session/create` with agentPreset=mpd as the mount proof; negative control

residual: The mpd preset still deviates from the installed standard preset in one config value, not a row: `tool-web { fetch: false }` (standard uses `true`). It predates this change, is a deliberate-looking local policy, and is left untouched (minimal diff); flag it if web_fetch is wanted for mpd sessions.
`tool-subagent { modelSelectionSettings }` is likewise not enabled (standard enables it) — long-standing, left as-is.
